Crop height x width at a random place in every training image.

Each training image is cropped at its own random position (torchvision RandomCrop); padding first adds a zero border on every side, so the crop may cover some of it. Validation and test take the centre crop of the same size, so the model's input shape is [height, width, C] in every phase.

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | No: Random Crop is a training image transform: the image batcher runs it on the ArrayFire device between Resize and Normalize; PipelineExecutor image transforms are not implemented |
| Training (the compiled model) | Yes, as a preprocessing step |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.

## Usage

```text
Resize 72 -> Random Crop 64 -> Horizontal Flip -> Normalize
```

```text
Validation and test take the centre crop of the same size, so the input shape stays [height, width, C] in every phase.
```

## Tips

- Resize a little larger than the crop (e.g. 72 -> 64) so crops differ.
- CIFAR recipe: Random Crop 32 with padding 4 on 32 x 32 images.
- Teaches the model that position does not decide the class.
